thread:
mila: Heads up — AuroraNet asked for a joint co-sell sandbox next week. They want a week-long shared POC with 3rd-party telemetry and a checklist for network setup. Need to confirm: reserved commit for POC, HSM support, and whether they can run an on-prem inference adapter.
dan: We should be explicit: Redwood Private needed for partner-hosted HSM or on-prem adapter. For hosted POC, we can support Bring-Your-Own-Key via cross-account KMS and we can provide ephemeral service tokens for the sandbox.
kevin: Traffic profile from AuroraNet: 30-120 rps bursts, median 20 rps, payloads small. Recommend a 3-node vGPU staging pool with autoscale burst to 5 nodes.
ops-oncall: On the telemetry front, we require a cross-account IAM role for push metrics or a read-only S3 bucket for logs. Also enforce request-masking for user data. Retention default 60 days for POC unless they buy extended.
sec-bot: Security checklist sent to AuroraNet. Items flagged: export controls, EU data residency, KMS split-key policy.
mila: Pricing — sales asked what baseline commit looks like. For a week POC, offer $2k trial credit plus a pre-authorized monthly reserve estimate that we can convert to a paid reserved plan. cc @billing-ops
billing-ops: Noted. We'll prepare a tentative co-sell quote with a 20% partner discount for first 3 months. Need expected avg rps and estimated token counts.
kevin: Quick token estimate: ~3k tokens/session * peak concurrency 50 = ~150k tokens/hr peak. Use Optimize recommendations for batching; I'll post numbers in the sheet.
dan: Operational note: for on-prem adapter, partner needs the edge agent (v1.3) and a direct peering setup. We can't support air-gapped installs in this POC window.
mila: Can someone paste the minimal curl test and the expected response so the partner can smoke test routing?
eops-oncall: (typo) ops-oncall: Use this:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/chat \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-chat-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"env-check"}]}'
```
Expected: {"status":"ok","message":"env-check","latency_ms":<num>}
kevin: Scheduling runbook Wed 11am PT to walkthrough provisioning, networking, and telemetry. Who's in?
mila: I'll run the sec part. dan: infra and adapter. kevin: infra + cost. billing-ops: I'll join for quote sign-off. ops-oncall: I'll cover telemetry and retention settings.
sec-bot: AuroraNet returned partially filled sec questionnaire; we'll need legal on export controls.
mila: OK — action items: dan: confirm Private vs hosted constraints and list HSM options. kevin: populate token/cost estimate sheet. billing-ops: draft co-sell quote with 20% discount. ops-oncall: create cross-account role and retention defaults. I'll consolidate docs and send to partner. Anything missing?
kevin: Add note about request throttling config: set burst limit 250 req/min for POC to protect shared pool.
mila: Good call. I'll add that to the runbook. :thumbsup:
